blurb: Guests rent brand-new 22-foot Maholo Tritoons with plush seating for up to 12 passengers. Rentals include the first 10 gallons of fuel, USCG safety gear, life jackets, and a diver-down flag. Boats can be used in Kings Bay, freshwater springs, and the Gulf of Mexico but not the Salt River.
